set.body: Calibrate the public novelty claim now, then promote each stronger scientific claim only after its evidence gate lands. The governing distinction is: the evidence-pairing calculus defines the scientific objects; executable estimand contracts keep execution from changing them. Acceptance: (1) public prose credits established RSA, decomposition, searchlight, generalization, and connectivity work; (2) demonstrated, implemented-but-undemonstrated, and prospective claims are visibly separated; (3) rsatoolbox parity establishes the common fixed-linear subset; (4) strict-extension demonstrations cover the inherited coherent/configuration family, a real rectangular analysis, conservative local/global accounting, and query-first execution; (5) a centralized failure gallery makes refusals reproducible; (6) README and novelty rhetoric are upgraded only from completed gate receipts.
set.title: Earn and promote the evidence-calculus novelty claims
